summary: Iteration 5 regression: verified that the iteration_4 critical bug (frontend sending date/time keys vs backend appointment_date/appointment_time) is FIXED end-to-end. UI submission now persists appointment_date + appointment_time to MongoDB. flatpickr 'invalid locale undefined' warning and React 'Invalid value for prop render' DOM warning are both gone. ChatFloater hrefs verified.

minor.issue: Test is now obsolete and still FAILS. It was written to reproduce the OLD broken contract where the frontend sent raw `date`/`time` keys and the backend silently dropped them. The actual fix moved the frontend to send `appointment_date`/`appointment_time` (correct keys). So a raw `{date, time}` payload still legitimately gets ignored by the backend (Pydantic extra='ignore' on ContactCreate) and persists nulls — which is the now-correct behavior because the live frontend no longer sends that shape. The test should be DELETED or rewritten to assert that the LIVE frontend payload (appointment_date/appointment_time) persists. The first test in the same file (test_backend_persists_appointment_date_time_with_correct_keys) PASSES.

action_items: Decide on test_frontend_compatible_payload_date_time_keys: either delete it (now an obsolete reproduction of the old bug) or rewrite to assert the post-fix payload shape (`appointment_date`/`appointment_time`) persists. As written, it documents an old contract that no longer matches reality.
critical_code_review_comments: ContactSection.jsx — explicit `appointment_date`/`appointment_time` keys are now sent and the `render` prop strips `render`, `options`, `onChange` before spreading to the native <input>. Clean.
ContactSection.jsx — flatpickr `locale` is now spread conditionally only when defined (sr/th fall back to default English). The earlier `locale: undefined` warning is gone.
server.py — ContactCreate + ContactMessage both declare appointment_date / appointment_time / selected_treatment; create_contact_message passes them through. Verified persisted via live POST + GET.
ChatFloater — WhatsApp href contains the seasonal Serbian greeting and booking template; Viber href = `viber://chat?number=%2B38162625500` with no `text=` param, matching spec exactly.

success_rate.backend: 100% (1/1 contract test passing; 2nd test in file is obsolete docs-of-old-bug, see action item)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_4 critical bug (frontend/backend key mismatch on appointment booking) is RESOLVED. E2E verified via real Flatpickr UI: user-picked 15.07.2026 / 14:30 -> Mongo record had appointment_date='2026-07-15', appointment_time='14:30', owner_email_sent=true. Console has zero flatpickr locale warnings and zero React render-prop warnings. Viber href matches spec (viber://chat?number=%2B38162625500). Only remaining cleanup item: backend test file still contains a now-obsolete failing test that reproduces the OLD bug (sending raw date/time keys); needs to be deleted or rewritten — not a product bug.
rca of the issue: Original RCA (iteration_4): frontend ContactSection spread {date,time} into axios POST; backend ContactCreate declared appointment_date/appointment_time and Pydantic silently dropped extras, so booking slot was never stored. Mitigation (applied by main agent and verified here): (1) onSubmit destructures {date,time,...rest} and posts {...rest, appointment_date:date, appointment_time:time, ...}; (2) ContactMessage now also persists these fields; (3) render prop strips non-DOM keys before spreading; (4) flatpickr locale spread conditionally. Live E2E now writes correct values to Mongo and triggers owner email containing the slot.
